description:
Job Summary 
 Role Title: Apprentice - Assistant Project Manager Tier: IC10 - Department/Division: Higher Education - Location: Hybrid - Employment Type: Full-time - Duration: 12 months - Target Start The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager for the Higher Education International Division will help to ensure the assembly, execution, and maintenance of major products according to specified objectives - budget, schedule, and adherence to quality standards. The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager is part of the broader team that executes annual plans and organizes and prioritizes tasks and teams to ensure delivery. You will work with authors, Pearson Content and Digital Producers, Quality Assurance (QA), Accessibility, Rights and Permissions (R&P) and vendor partners to deliver stable, high-quality products to improve learner outcomes and maximize instructor impact. You will also manage production schedules for print and digital assets. This role is ideal for a fresher or early-career professional who is eager to learn project management, risk assessment and mitigation, and digital product creation in the higher education space. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Content production of selected print, digital, and supplemental content. Production of digital courseware content that will be used in both print and digital delivery. Maintain legacy data on a vast number of series-specific titles, including print books and editorial supplements, while at the same time helping to guide the list through the transition to a nextGen digital format. Learn how to act as point-person throughout entire lifecycle process, respond to queries from various stakeholders, serve as knowledge resource for Portfolio team. Learn how to provide high-level management of a large number of primary authors, development editors, technical editors, supplement authors, copyeditors, and freelance project managers. Negotiate rates, prioritize work. Learn how to provide communication across cross-functional teams. Includes initiating launch meetings, serving as meeting moderator, and maintaining status reports. Coordinating and keeping track of budgets in all the projects. Learn to drive creation of project schedules; enforce adherence; provide accountability charter for delays. Serve as liaison with Rights and Permission team; ensure quality of coverage; escalate any schedule delays or budget concerns. Identify and manage vendors to schedule, budget, and quality compliance; provide feedback on performance. Enforce system maintenance and data integrity of records; oversee invoice processing and reconciliation. Support in contributing to cover and internal design process. 
 
 Desirable Skills and Attributes 
 Ability to think and act independently to seek out resolutions and problem-solve on a daily basis. Ability to influence and negotiate where necessary with peers, project team, sponsors/stakeholders, and other internal teams as needed. Ability to respond confidently to conflicts and manage situations positively, proactively escalating ongoing issues and showing solid judgment. Demonstrates highly active ownership of projects, possesses ability to proactively assess and mitigate risk, and actively poses solutions to problems. Communicates effectively (written and verbally) with peers, project team, and sponsors/stakeholders. Shows strong command of the English language. Able to assess and manage across a full project breadth and depth, ensuring a successful delivery of products. Ability to work with cross-functional teams delivering both digital and print product outputs. Diligent attention to detail. Strong organization skills: Self-organizing and self-motivating. Strong time-management abilities--organizing tasks in a logical and efficient manner allowing for multitasking and making appropriate calls on prioritization. 
 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Recent graduates or candidates with less than one to three years of experience are encouraged to apply. Must meet requirements under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and be registered on the NATS portal. Must be legally eligible to work in India. 
 
 Experience You Will Gain 
 Practical exposure to Project Management operations, scheduling and budgeting. Hands-on experience in risk assessment and mitigation, and professional communication. Experience in creating and sharing schedules using Smartsheets. Understanding of how digital learning products are built and created. Opportunity to work with Product, Content Solutions, QA, and R&P teams in a professional business environment. 
 
 Work Schedule 
 This is a full-time apprenticeship from Monday to Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. The role involves working across several geographies and requires occasional flexibility in supporting the business beyond regular office hours. 
 
 Location 
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India - Hybrid

title: Consultant-GIS
description:
**Job Description**
 As a GIS Consultant at WSP, you will support the Transformation \& Digital Insights team in delivering high‑quality geospatial services across multidisciplinary projects. You’ll design project geodatabases, publish/services, configure web and mobile GIS, automate workflows, and ensure quality. You’ll also contribute to methods, documentation, and outputs that meet project timelines, budgets, and client expectations. This position is ideal for someone looking to develop strong technical foundations and grow within a multidisciplinary digital environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 ▪ Provide day\-to\-day GIS support across project teams and business functions.

 ▪ Publish/manage map, feature, and geoprocessing services (ArcGIS Enterprise/Online).
   

  

 ▪ Configure web GIS solutions (Experience Builder, Web AppBuilder, Sites/Hub, Dashboards, StoryMaps).

 ▪ Participate in professional development activities to maintain and improve skills.
   

  

 ▪ Support junior staff with reviews and informal mentoring; contribute to bids where applicable.
   

  

 ▪ Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and support overseas/remote GIS staff coordination.
   

  

**Essential Skills**
 ▪ 5\+ years of professional GIS experience with a track record of delivery.
   

  

 ▪ Proficiency across the Esri platform: ArcGIS Pro, Enterprise Geodatabases, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online.
   

  

 ▪ Solid geodatabase design and strong grasp of relational database concepts.
   

  

 ▪ Experience publishing/consuming services and administering items/permissions.
   

  

 ▪ Working knowledge of Python/ArcPy for analysis/automation; ModelBuilder familiarity.
   

  

 ▪ Web GIS configuration experience (Experience Builder, Dashboards, StoryMaps, Sites/Hub).

 ▪ Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in GIS, Geography, or a related geospatial discipline.

 ▪ Membership of a relevant professional institution (desirable).

title: Programme Associate- Industrial Heat Decarbonisation
company: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST)
description:
**Programme Associate \- Industrial Heat Decarbonisation** 




  





 The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability \& Technology (iFOREST), is looking for an experienced and dynamic professional to support \& lead the organisation’s research initiatives and policy engagement in the Industrial transition and decarbonization.
 



 A successful applicant must have a proven aptitude for analytical research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, and excellent communication skills with government, industry and related agencies. The candidate should ideally have sound
 **technical and policy knowledge and experience knowledge of working in Energy Efficiency, Energy management, Boiler\-based industries, and MSME sectors such as\- Food \& beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma etc. Overall knowledge of industrial decarbonization is desirable.** 




  





**Location** 
 : Sector 132, Noida, India
 



**Required Experience** 
 : 5\+ years
 



  





***About iFOREST***




 iFOREST is an independent not\-for\-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment\-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.
 



 Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub\-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.
 



 To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence\-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.
 



***The Industrial Decarbonization Programmme***




 The Industrial Decarbonization Programme is a part of iFOREST’s flagship initiative on Enabling Energy Transitions. The objective of the programme is to steer a green industry transition to support green growth and green jobs, while improving local environmental conditions and achieving climate goals. The focus is on conducing evidence\-based research, including modelling studies to develop comprehensive roadmaps, identify policy solutions and provide technical support for industrial decarbonisation in sectors like steel, fertilizer, cement, bricks and at\-risk MSME sectors, as a transition in these sectors will affect the largest number of consumers and enterprises.
 



 The Programme is strongly focused on technical research and stakeholder engagement (especially with government departments/agencies and the industry) to achieve a green transition of fossil fuel\-dependent factories that are associated with various industries.
 



***The Role***




 The Programme Associate will be responsible for the execution of research and engagement outputs pertaining to industrial decarbonisation across boiler based industries and MSME sector. This would entail conducting impactful research and multi\-stakeholder engagement, with the support of a dedicated team. In addition, they would also be expected to identify new areas of work to support institutional goals.
 



  





 Specific tasks to be undertaken are:
 



**Support and execute the research initiatives of the Programme.** 



* Contribute to designing research assignments, including developing research strategy and methodology as well as identifying specific activities and tasks.
* Conduct in\-depth primary and secondary research including quantitative and qualitative assessments.
* Remain updated with the latest tools and techniques for executing qualitative and quantitative research.
* Write research documents, including analytical reports and policy papers based on evidence.
* Mentor young researchers in in the team in executing research assignments.
* Stay abreast with the latest developments and debates in the sector.



  





**Lead the outreach and communication** 



* Design and manage a comprehensive outreach strategy for the programme as well as for projects therein.
* Enable the generation of policy\-research partnerships with government, industry and other stakeholders.
* Author and review articles and other forms of communication materials suitable for the public, government stakeholders, and donors.
* Build and leverage relationships to design and conduct roundtables, convenings, and report release meetings with government, industry, civil society, media, etc.



  





**Additional duties** 



* Contribute to shaping the overall strategy for the programme, aligned with institutional priorities, sector\-specific issues and ongoing work of other key institutions.
* Identify new pathways, initiatives, and partnerships that contribute to programmatic goals.
* Support development of new concept notes, proposals, theory of change and budgets for projects/interventions that further institutional objectives.
* Contribute to the institution’s brand building by representing iFOREST on various public platforms.
* Execute any related assignments that may arise in relation to the tasks or for further enhancement of the programme.



  





***Qualification \& Work Experience***



* A Bachelors or
 **Master's in engineering is a must, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Energy System, and Environmental or related streams.**
* The candidate must have experience of research and work on
 **Energy efficiency; Energy Management; Boiler\-based industries and efficiency of MSME sectors, such as\- Food and Beverages, Textile, Chemicals, Pharma, etc.**
* Knowledge of industrial decarbonization strategies is also a must.
* A
 **minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience** 
 in industrial research, advisory, or consulting is required.



  





**Competencies \& Responsibilities** 




**The successful candidate should have the following competencies:** 



* Strong
 **technical knowledge** 
 of industrial operation, energy and decarbonization
* Strongly
 **quantitative skills, with ability to work with large datasets** 
 .

title: Writer Intern
description:
**About the Role:** 




 We’re looking for a strong writer with excellent English, sharp research skills, and an eye for storytelling to join our application team.
 



 As an Admissions Content Intern, you’ll work on real student applications and help transform their academic experiences, achievements, and aspirations into compelling application narratives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Draft, edit, and refine SOPs, LORs, personal statements, university essays, and resumes/CVs under senior writer/editor guidance.
* Understand student profiles and identify their strongest stories, experiences, and differentiators.
* Convert student inputs, questionnaires, and meeting notes into clear and compelling narratives.
* Conduct university\- and program\-specific research to tailor application documents.
* Strengthen documents for structure, narrative flow, clarity, grammar, tone, and authenticity.
* Ensure documents are personalized, credible, and free from generic or AI\-sounding language.
* Incorporate feedback across multiple rounds of revisions while maintaining accuracy and consistency.
* Work closely with senior writers and counselors to develop the student’s overall application narrative and positioning.
* Manage multiple student documents and deadlines simultaneously.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong storytelling skills and the ability to write with clarity and personality.
* Excellent research and reading\-comprehension skills.
* Strong command of grammar and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand a person’s experiences and turn them into meaningful stories.
* Comfortable receiving feedback and rewriting extensively.
* Prior experience with SOPs, essays, resumes, college applications, or long\-form writing is a plus.
* Students/recent graduates from English, Journalism, Literature, Liberal Arts, Communications, Psychology, Management, or related fields are welcome.



  





**What You'll Gain:** 



* Internship Completion Certificate
* Exposure to top global universities including Oxford, Cambridge, Ivy League, LSE, Imperial, and more
* Hands\-on experience with SOPs, LORs, essays, and resumes rather than generic content writing
* PPO / Full\-Time Opportunity based on performance
* Performance recognition for exceptional work



  





**Internship Details:** 




**Duration:** 
 3 Months
 



**Location:** 
 On\-site — World Trade Tower, Sector 16, Noida
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹10,000–₹14,000/month, depending on writing ability, experience, and overall profile.
 



  





**About Intelligent Education:** 




 Intelligent Education is a premium study abroad consulting firm helping ambitious students gain admission to leading universities globally. Our application team works closely with students to develop compelling, authentic, and strategically positioned application documents.
 



  





**Join Us:** 




 If you’re someone who loves writing, research, storytelling, and understanding people, this is an opportunity to build real expertise in international university applications, admissions writing, and student storytelling.
 



 Apply now to join Intelligent Education.

description:

 WSP has an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic and motivated individual to join our growing Engagement \& Consultation team.
